explanation: Use Pascal’s recurrence: choose(x,y)=choose(x−1,y)+choose(x−1,y−1). Memoize the recursive states, with one way to choose zero elements or all elements. The annotated entry point uses the two-dimensional table.
spaceComplexity: O(nk) table plus O(n) recursion stack
